decision: Converge galway/muckross/kinsale on main: merge deploy/fleet-latest-2026-09 and #501 (web plane mounts the Docker socket, fleet-wide), and let scripts/deploy.sh take DAAX_IMAGE_OVERRIDE/DAAX_TERMINAL_IMAGE_OVERRIDE (digest-only) over the sourced env file's pins.
rationale: Hosts tracked a per-host branch that main did not contain. The operator chose #501 fleet-wide on 2026-09-13 knowing the web plane becomes root-equivalent on the host. The env file is sourced after the caller's environment, so without *_OVERRIDE a fleet roller's digest was overwritten by the pin and every host silently redeployed what it already ran.
alternatives: docker-socket-proxy for the web plane (narrower; deferred)
keep hosts on the fleet branch (rejected: no single source)
have the fleet roller rewrite env files mid-deploy (rejected: unreviewed on-disk drift)
validation: producer Claude Opus 5; validator gpt-5.6-sol; r1 found 1 P1 (digest rollback), 2 P2, 2 P3 — all fixed with tests

decision: Every fleet host runs code-server, watchtower, hawkeye and provenance from digest-pinned signed GHCR images via deploy/docker-compose.yml; deploy.sh gains --effective (DEPLOY_SH_API=2) so the fleet roller reads effective pins instead of grepping; a partial daax/daax-terminal baseline is refused before mutation; a pre-switch failure on a fresh host tears down.
rationale: Operator: all things run on all hosts. code-server was built per host (four different images, none pinnable, perl CRITICALs unfixable by deploy). Cross-model review r3 found rollback to a partial baseline recreated a topology that never existed, and pre-switch fresh failures left partial stacks.
alternatives: keep supporting services chamonix-only (rejected by operator)
build code-server per host (rejected: no digest)
validation: producer Claude Opus 5; validator gpt-5.6-sol r3; new tests mutation-checked

decision: deploy.sh treats all six services as one transaction: capture/restore/recreate daax, daax-terminal, code-server, watchtower, hawkeye, provenance; supporting services absent at capture are removed on rollback; supporting pulls and --wait health are fatal; partial daax/terminal baseline is refused by inspect before any tag; provenance volume mounted at /root/.local/share/provenance; cap_drop ALL + /health healthchecks on the three new services.
rationale: Cross-model review r4: rollback reverted only two planes; non-fatal supporting failures let a deploy report success without the stack; the partial-baseline check ran after capture moved :rollback. Measured 2026-09-13: each pinned image serves /health under cap_drop ALL + no-new-privileges; provenance's entrypoint tests /data but init writes under /root/.local/share/provenance (init is idempotent).
alternatives: keep supporting services best-effort (rejected: fleet requires them)
recreate absent services on rollback (rejected: not the prior state)
validation: producer Claude Opus 5; validator gpt-5.6-sol r4; 92 deploy tests, 5 mutations caught

decision: Agent View on fleet targets reaches agentd over the tailnet (https://agents.<host>.poley.dev) with a read-only peer bearer session read from AGENTVIEW_DAEMON_TOKEN_FILE; the Console iframe loads agents.<host> instead of <host>:7717; no host relay and no extra docker network.
rationale: The Console URL <this host>:7717 never served anything on a fleet name (agentd binds loopback). The Overview proxy needed a socat relay (galway only) that exposed agentd's unauthenticated loopback API to every container on daax-net (cross-model review P1). Operator chose tailnet + token over a daax-only relay.
tradeoff: Off loopback agentd withholds raw prompts/file contents (dist-agent ADR 0014) - the proxy never forwards those routes; a peer session is refused control, so the signal POST stays unavailable on Linux hosts as before. Sessions expire in 30 days; renewal mints only within 10 days of expiry to avoid piling sessions.
alternatives: daax-only relay restricted by source address (rejected by operator)
relay + dedicated docker network (rejected: wrong layer)
validation: producer Claude Opus 5; validator gpt-5.6-sol (rounds recorded in PR)
rollout: The fleet env files gain AGENTVIEW_DAEMON_URL/_TOKEN_FILE/AGENTVIEW_TOKEN_HOST_DIR only in the repin PR that follows this image's publish, so no host ever runs the new configuration on an image that sends no token. galway's relay is retired by deploy/host/retire-agentd-relay.sh after the deploy is verified.
